verdict.rationale: Viam's own materials claim cloud-managed fleet monitoring and alerting and remote monitoring as a Fleet Management feature. A fleet API organizes machines by organization and location and mirrors what the web UI can do, and per-machine health is exposed through GetMachineStatus and online confirmation. Teleop is also documented for building monitoring dashboards. However, the evidence never shows a single fleet-wide dashboard displaying health, location, and status together; these elements come from marketing bullets and per-machine or API docs. Missing for 10: documentation of a unified fleet-level dashboard view, explicit fleet-wide health/status rollup, evidence that 'location' covers physical position rather than just an organizational grouping, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
